major_features: Precision decimal rounder with live visual canvas preview
candidate_ideas.name: PathPurge SVG
candidate_ideas.pain: Command-line optimizers lack an interactive visual preview of how individual path changes (like rounding decimals or converting absolute to relative commands) affect the rendering.
candidate_ideas.problem: Exported SVGs contain bloated paths, redundant commands, and excessive decimal precision that increase asset size and complicate CSS animations.
candidate_ideas.solution: A local-first SVG editor that parses path data, displays an interactive visual canvas showing control points, and provides granular sliders to adjust decimal precision, toggle relative/absolute commands, and instantly export optimized SVG code.
candidate_ideas.verification: Load an SVG path string with high decimal precision, apply a precision-reduction filter via JavaScript, and assert that the resulting path string length is reduced while rendering correctly on an HTML5 canvas.

major_features: Auto-padded markdown code exporter with live preview
candidate_ideas.name: Markdown Table Architect
candidate_ideas.pain: Simple changes like adding a column or changing text alignment require manually recalculating and spacing out markdown pipe characters in text editors.
candidate_ideas.problem: Creating, editing, and maintaining visually complex tables in Markdown format is tedious and error-prone.
candidate_ideas.solution: An interactive, spreadsheet-like visual grid specifically designed for Markdown tables. Users can visually insert/delete rows and columns, toggle alignment, paste CSV/Excel data, and instantly copy beautifully formatted, auto-padded Markdown code.
candidate_ideas.target_user: Technical writers, developers, and documentation managers
candidate_ideas.verification: Programmatically populate the visual grid, trigger a column-add event, and verify the exported markdown text contains the new column with correct alignment characters.

major_features: Visual state machine graph generator for regex syntax
candidate_ideas.name: Regex FlowMapper
candidate_ideas.pain: Standard regex testers only show if a match succeeded or failed, without explaining how the engine traversed the pattern or where catastrophic backtracking occurred.
candidate_ideas.problem: Complex regular expressions with lookaheads, lookbehinds, and nested capture groups are hard to read and debug.
candidate_ideas.solution: A local-first regex parser that translates regex patterns into a visual, interactive state machine graph. It highlights capture groups, quantifiers, and branches, allowing users to step through a test string character-by-character to watch the matching flow.
candidate_ideas.target_user: Software engineers and computer science students
candidate_ideas.verification: Input the pattern `/(a|b)+c/` and a test string, and verify that the parser correctly generates a state tree containing nodes for alternation, repetition, and literal matching.

major_features: CSS @font-face generator with optimized unicode-range blocks
candidate_ideas.name: Unicode Range Optimizer
candidate_ideas.pain: Developers must lookup unicode hex ranges for specific languages or custom character sets manually, leading to bloated font loading.
candidate_ideas.problem: Manually configuring CSS `@font-face` `unicode-range` descriptors to split large fonts into optimized, lazy-loaded subsets is incredibly tedious.
candidate_ideas.solution: A local-first tool where users paste their website's text or select target languages. The app analyzes the character set, maps them to exact unicode ranges, groups them into optimized CSS `@font-face` blocks, and visualizes which glyphs are covered.
candidate_ideas.target_user: Web performance engineers and internationalization developers
candidate_ideas.verification: Input a string of mixed English and Cyrillic text, and verify that the tool outputs the correct corresponding unicode range string (e.g., `U+0020-007F, U+0400-04FF`).

major_features: Interactive layout builder with visual vector overlays
Real-time flex-grow and flex-shrink dimension calculator
Grid track and gap overlay guides
candidate_ideas.name: Flexbox & Grid Overlay Debugger
candidate_ideas.pain: Browser dev tools offer static overlays but don't allow live, interactive tweaking of flex/grid parameters side-by-side with visual guides of remaining space distribution.
candidate_ideas.problem: Visualizing how browser layout engines calculate flexbox grow/shrink factors and grid tracks is difficult just by looking at static code.
candidate_ideas.solution: A visual layout sandbox where users can add virtual items, define flex/grid CSS rules, and see dynamic visual vector overlays showing growth boundaries, shrink limits, gap dimensions, and alignment lines in real-time.
candidate_ideas.verification: Set a container to `display: flex` with three items having `flex-grow` values, and verify the tool correctly calculates and displays the proportional growth dimensions of each item.
